recognitionRules: Set the main title in Palatino and use Futura for navigation, study IDs and table labels.
Use deep purple #563B75 table headers with white labels and pale lavender #F0EBF5 body-cell shading; retain black reading text on white pages.
Repeat the source woven strip using lavender horizontal threads and purple, rust and charcoal vertical threads; preserve visible crossings and white breathing room.
Carry study IDs through inventory, overlap and synthesis, showing convergence and disagreement with explicit labels and source links.

writingLinks.name: Research register
writingLinks.reason: Cross-study synthesis that keeps contradictions visible and avoids invalid pooling.

quote: Bring the studies together. Keep their differences attached.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Proposed new WOVEN LOGIC wordmark in Futura with two crossing thin rules interrupted at their intersection, using synthesis purple or black. This simplified open-weave symbol is a new editorial logo proposal; retain the native multicolor woven strip as a separate supporting motif.
invariants: Set the main title in Palatino and use Futura for navigation, study IDs and table labels.
Use deep purple #563B75 table headers with white labels and pale lavender #F0EBF5 body-cell shading; retain black reading text on white pages.
Repeat the source woven strip using lavender horizontal threads and purple, rust and charcoal vertical threads; preserve visible crossings and white breathing room.
adaptations: A one-page synthesis retains study IDs and the disagreement row.
Long editions can expand the inventory without changing the type hierarchy.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
